discovery: Discovery of photonic crystals and photonic band gaps for controlling the flow of light
rationale: Recent prizes covered quantum circuits (2025), machine learning (2024) and attosecond physics (2023), so a turn to condensed-matter optics is plausible. Photonic band-gap materials are a foundational, heavily cited idea with broad uses in photonics and telecommunications, and both founders are long-standing laureate candidates.
